summary.text: Emily Callaway is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 37 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is running unopposed for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Emily Callaway graduated from Whitefield Academy.
She succeeded Democrat Jeffery M. Donohue in District 37.

In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Families and Children, Health and Family Services, Primary and Secondary Education, and Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations committees.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she listed her campaign messages as protecting constitutional rights, conserving Christian values and improving the community.
